biotools.summary: PDP-Miner is an AI/ML tool that detects prophage tail proteins with depolymerase domains across bacterial genomes, aiding in the identification of potential antibiotic alternatives. It leverages a machine learning prediction tool and allows for post-hoc domain annotation for validation.
